embeds.title: 🔴 DentaQuest Data Breach Exposed Info of 2.6 Million Accounts
embeds.description:
**Actor:** ShinyHunters
DentaQuest, a major dental benefits administrator, reportedly suffered a data breach affecting 2.6 million accounts. ShinyHunters claimed to have stolen over 234 GB of data and publicly leaked it after allegedly failing to reach an agreement with the company. The exposed data included email addresses, full names, phone numbers, government-issued IDs, health insurance information, genders, and dates of birth. DentaQuest confirmed the breach on June 2, stating it caused limited disruption to customer service.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🟡 2 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** n/a
